description: Open-source music foundation model for generating complete songs from text, lyric prompts, and style tags, with controllable song structure and broad multilingual lyric conditioning.

request.name: duration_sec
request.description: Maximum generated audio duration in seconds; must be positive when set; default 120.

request.name: temperature
request.description: Audio-token sampling temperature; must be positive when set; default 1.0.

request.name: guidance_scale
request.description: MuLa classifier-free guidance scale; must be positive when set; default 1.5.

request.name: codec_duration_sec
request.description: Codec detokenization chunk duration in seconds; must be positive when set; default 29.76.

request.name: codec_guidance_scale
request.description: Codec classifier-free guidance scale; must be positive when set; default 1.25.

request.name: infinite_mode
request.description: Generate long outputs by splitting lyrics into bounded HeartMuLa requests.

request.name: text_chunk_size
request.description: Maximum characters per text chunk in infinite mode; default 4096.

request.name: infinite_chunk_audio_duration_ms
request.description: Maximum generated audio duration per infinite-mode chunk in milliseconds; default 240000.

request.name: seed
request.description: Generation seed for reproducible output; default 1234.

session.name: weight_type
session.description: MuLa and codec weight storage type; default native.

session.name: model_weight_type
session.description: MuLa weight storage type; defaults to weight_type when set, otherwise native.

session.name: codec_weight_type
session.description: Codec weight storage type; defaults to weight_type when set, otherwise native.

session.name: model_weight_context_mb
session.description: MuLa weight context size in MiB; default 512.

session.name: codec_weight_context_mb
session.description: Codec weight context size in MiB; default 512.

session.name: constant_context_mb
session.description: MuLa reusable constant context size in MiB; default 256.

session.name: backbone_prefill_graph_arena_mb
session.description: MuLa backbone prefill graph arena size in MiB; default 1536.

session.name: backbone_step_graph_arena_mb
session.description: MuLa backbone cached-step graph arena size in MiB; default 1536.

session.name: decoder_prefill_graph_arena_mb
session.description: MuLa decoder prefill graph arena size in MiB; default 512.

session.name: decoder_step_graph_arena_mb
session.description: MuLa decoder cached-step graph arena size in MiB; default 512.

session.name: frame_embedding_graph_arena_mb
session.description: MuLa frame-embedding graph arena size in MiB; default 512.

session.name: codec_flow_estimator_graph_arena_mb
session.description: Codec flow-estimator graph arena size in MiB; default 2048.

session.name: codec_conditioning_graph_arena_mb
session.description: Codec conditioning graph arena size in MiB; default 512.

session.name: codec_scalar_decoder_graph_arena_mb
session.description: Codec scalar-decoder graph arena size in MiB; default 1536.

session.name: mem_saver
session.description: Release staged runtime graphs after each request; default false.
